_comment: TETHER target config for DroneBridge for ESP32 v2.4.1 (generic esp32 flavour). Keys verified against v2.4.1 main/db_parameters.c and cross-checked with board 1's boot log (notes/evidence/board1-bootlog.txt). Keys starting with '_' are stripped by db_apply.sh. wifi_pass is a placeholder: db_apply.sh substitutes $TETHER_AP_PASS and refuses to send CHANGE_ME.
_tx_power: NOT SETTABLE: v2.4.1 has no TX-power parameter (see notes/dronebridge.md). Mitigate with distance/shielding, not config.
_flow_control: gpio_rts == gpio_cts disables HW flow control; pins are then left untouched (UART_PIN_NO_CHANGE).
_pins: GPIO19=TX, GPIO18=RX: safe on WROOM and WROVER, same header side as TX0/RX0. TX must differ from RX, or the control module aborts and UDP 14550 / TCP 5760 never open (v2.4.1 db_serial.c L78, db_esp32_control.c L663-685).
_ap_ip_note: ap_ip is built at apply time from _ap_ip_octets (no dotted-quad literal stored; host tooling mangles them).
_baud: 115200 by decision. 460800 and 921600 are selectable in v2.4.1 if the wire becomes the bottleneck.
